I want to make sure I point you to the right info, but I need a bit more to go on.

A couple of things would help:

- Which little one are you asking about, Ash or Bo? Their typical sleep ranges are very different at 3 months versus 7 years.
- What amount of sleep are they actually getting right now (total hours, and roughly how broken up)?

Once I know that, I can tell you how it lines up with what's typical for their stage — and flag anything worth mentioning to your pediatric office rather than guessing.
